tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets from Zendesk. Returns tickets with full details including subject, status, priority, assignee, requester, and timestamps. Supports pagination and sorting by created/updated date.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific support ticket by its ID. Returns the full ticket object including subject, description, status, priority, assignee, requester, tags, and all timestamps.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new support ticket in Zendesk. Requires a subject and initial comment body. Optionally set priority, type, tags, assignee, group, and requester. Returns the newly created ticket with its assigned ID.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Update an existing support ticket. Change the subject, status, priority, type, tags, assignee, or group. Only specified fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged. Returns the updated ticket.

tools.name: delete_ticket
tools.description: Permanently delete a support ticket by its ID. This action cannot be undone. The ticket and all its comments will be removed from Zendesk.

tools.name: list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a support ticket. Returns comments with author information, body text, creation timestamp, and public/private status. Supports pagination for tickets with many comments.

tools.name: add_ticket_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing support ticket. Comments can be public (visible to the requester) or private (internal notes for agents only). Returns the updated ticket with the new comment.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Zendesk user.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Zendesk user by their ID.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Zendesk account. Optionally filter by role and paginate results.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List all organizations in the Zendesk account with optional pagination.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Zendesk organization by its ID.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List all agent groups in the Zendesk account.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across tickets, users, and organizations using Zendesk search syntax. Examples: 'type:ticket status:open', 'type:user role:agent', 'type:organization name:Acme', 'assignee:me priority:high'

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: List all shared and personal views in the Zendesk account.

tools.name: get_view_tickets
tools.description: Get the list of tickets in a specific Zendesk view. Use list_views to discover available views.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in the Zendesk account with their usage counts.
